title: 显式状态机 vs 自由 ReAct：步数与工具调用数对照
expected_output:
状态机路径 = PENDING -> READ -> VALIDATE -> WRITE -> NOTIFY -> DONE
状态机步数 = 5
状态机工具调用 = 4
自由 ReAct 步数 = 7
自由 ReAct 工具调用 = 6
状态机允许 VALIDATE->WRITE = True
状态机拒绝 READ->NOTIFY = True
状态机步数 <= 自由ReAct步数 = True
状态机路径可重复 = True
code:
"""ex09 同一任务的两条控制流：显式状态机 vs 自由 ReAct。"""

STATES = {
    "PENDING": ["READ"],
    "READ": ["VALIDATE"],
    "VALIDATE": ["WRITE", "FAILED"],
    "WRITE": ["NOTIFY"],
    "NOTIFY": ["DONE"],
    "DONE": [],
    "FAILED": ["READ"],
}
TOOL_OF = {"READ": "query_db", "VALIDATE": "check_schema",
           "WRITE": "write_db", "NOTIFY": "send_email"}


def run_state_machine(start, target, max_steps=10):
    path = [start]
    calls = []
    cur = start
    for _ in range(max_steps):
        nxt = STATES[cur][0] if STATES[cur] else None
        if nxt is None:
            break
        if nxt in TOOL_OF:          # 终态 DONE 不是工具调用
            calls.append(TOOL_OF[nxt])
        path.append(nxt)
        cur = nxt
        if cur == target:
            break
    return path, calls


def run_free_react():
    """自由 ReAct：模型可能跳过步骤、重复动作（固定剧本模拟一次真实的绕路）。"""
    return [
        ("Thought: 先读表", "query_db"),
        ("Thought: 直接写库吧", "write_db"),            # 跳过校验
        ("Thought: 好像不对，回去读表", "query_db"),     # 重复动作
        ("Thought: 这次先校验", "check_schema"),
        ("Thought: 再写库", "write_db"),
        ("Thought: 通知", "send_email"),
        ("Thought: 完成", "finish"),
    ]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    path, calls = run_state_machine("PENDING", "DONE")
    print("状态机路径 = %s" % " -> ".join(path))
    print("状态机步数 = %d" % (len(path) - 1))
    print("状态机工具调用 = %d" % len(calls))

    script = run_free_react()
    print("自由 ReAct 步数 = %d" % len(script))
    print("自由 ReAct 工具调用 = %d"
          % len([c for _, c in script if c != "finish"]))

    print("状态机允许 VALIDATE->WRITE = %s" % ("WRITE" in STATES["VALIDATE"]))
    print("状态机拒绝 READ->NOTIFY = %s" % ("NOTIFY" not in STATES["READ"]))
    print("状态机步数 <= 自由ReAct步数 = %s" % ((len(path) - 1) <= len(script)))
    print("状态机路径可重复 = %s"
          % (run_state_machine("PENDING", "DONE")[0] == path))
